questions.subject: COMPUTER_NETWORKS

questions.explanation: Ethernet defines framing and medium access for local networks. It provides best-effort delivery: corrupted frames may be dropped and higher layers must handle loss and ordering. Switches learn MAC addresses and forward frames selectively, which reduces collisions but does not turn the link into a reliable, connection-oriented service. The concrete addresses in the case do not change the rule.
questions.hint: Ask whether a dropped frame is recovered at this layer.
questions.learningObjective: identify and explain Ethernet using a packet-level scenario
